title: Training Note — Report-Day Bonus on Ridgeline Special Order Services Damage Allowances (Paid-in-Full Programs)
content:
A damage claim registered quickly after pickup or delivery earns a report bonus on the damage allowance of a Ridgeline Special Order Services order in a program paid in full at order.

**Clause.** The report bonus depends on the day the damage claim was registered, counted in calendar days from the completed date: a claim registered on the completed date itself gives a report bonus of 1.5; a claim registered on the next calendar day gives 0.75; otherwise the report bonus is 0.

The report bonus is a number of percentage points added to the percentage of the delivered price at which the damage allowance is figured.

## Questions answered by the clause

**Which date counts for the claim?** The calendar date on which the damage claim on the order was registered; where the order carries more than one damage claim, the most recently registered one.

**Which date counts for the handover?** The completed date of the order — the date of pickup or delivery.

**Does the hour of registration matter?** No. Only the calendar day counts: any hour on the completed date gives 1.5, any hour on the next calendar day gives 0.75.

## Day table (hypothetical completed date 4 May)

| Damage claim registered | Calendar days after the completed date | Report bonus (points) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 May at 18:20 | 0 | 1.5 |
| 5 May at 08:05 | 1 | 0.75 |
| 6 May at 00:10 | 2 | 0 |

**Hypothetical figure.** A percentage of 10 before the bonus becomes 11.5 for a claim registered on the completed date and 10.75 for a claim registered on the next calendar day.
